name: std::use_facet
intro:
Obtains a reference to a facet implemented by loc.

The program is ill-formed if Facet is not a facet whose definition contains the public static member id or it is a volatile-qualified facet.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
loc

 -

 the locale object to query

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Returns a reference to the facet. The reference returned by this function is valid as long as any std::locale object refers to that facet.

sections.title: Notes

examples.output:
Your currency string is USD
Your currency string is EUR
Your currency string is GBP

summary: Obtains a reference to a facet implemented by loc.
